narrative_vs_numbers.summary: Infosys executed with high margin discipline, consistently landing operating margins within its guided 20% to 22% range across all audited quarters (achieving 21% in FY26 and 21.1% in Q1 FY27). Revenue growth momentum expanded from 2.9% Y-on-Y CC in Q2 FY26 to a full-year FY26 delivery of 3.1%, meeting the upgraded 3% to 3.5% guidance band, though macro uncertainties led management to cut upper-end FY27 growth guidance to 1.5% to 3% in Q1 FY27.

guided.metric: FY27 Constant Currency Revenue Growth Guidance
guided.guidance: Full year FY27 constant currency revenue growth guidance of 1.5% to 3.5% year-on-year.
guided.source: Q4 FY26 Concall Transcript (27-Apr-2026), PDF p. 4 — "Our revenue growth guidance for the financial year 2027 is 1.5% to 3.5% growth year-on-year in constant currency terms."

guided.guidance: Operating margin guidance for financial year '27 is 20% to 22%.
guided.source: Q4 FY26 Concall Transcript (27-Apr-2026), PDF p. 4 — "Our operating margin guidance for financial year '27 is 20% to 22%."

delivered.metric: FY27 Constant Currency Revenue Growth Guidance
delivered.actual: Q1 revenue growth was at 2.4% Y-on-Y and 1% Q-on-Q in constant currency terms.
delivered.source: Q1 FY27 Concall Transcript (28-Jul-2026), PDF p. 5 — "Our revenue growth for Q1 was at 2.4% Y-on-Y and 1% Q-on-Q in constant currency terms."

delivered.actual: Operating margin delivered at 21.1% in Q1.
delivered.source: Q1 FY27 Concall Transcript (28-Jul-2026), PDF p. 5 — "Our large deals, $3.6 bn at 61% net new, operating margin at 21.1%, free cash flow at $955 mn."

quarters.commentary: Infosys delivered Q1 revenue growth of 2.4% Y-on-Y in constant currency and operating margins of 21.1%, meeting initial expectations but prompting management to lower full-year FY27 growth guidance due to client-specific impacts.

guided.metric: FY26 Constant Currency Revenue Growth Guidance
guided.guidance: Revised revenue growth guidance for this financial year is 3% to 3.5% growth in constant currency.
guided.source: Q3 FY26 Concall Transcript (19-Jan-2026), PDF p. 4 — "The new revenue growth guidance for this financial year is 3% to 3.5% growth in constant currency."

guided.guidance: Operating margin guidance for the financial year remains the same at 20% to 22%.
guided.source: Q3 FY26 Concall Transcript (19-Jan-2026), PDF p. 4 — "Our operating margin guidance for the financial year remains the same at 20% to 22%."

delivered.metric: FY26 Constant Currency Revenue Growth Guidance
delivered.actual: Growth of 3.1% for the full year in constant currency terms.
delivered.source: Q4 FY26 Concall Transcript (27-Apr-2026), PDF p. 4 — "We delivered a strong performance in financial year 2026. We had growth of 3.1% for the full year in constant currency terms."
Q4 FY26 Concall Transcript (27-Apr-2026), PDF p. 7 — "So if you look at the margins, the full year margins is at 21%."

quarters.commentary: Full-year FY26 constant currency growth reached 3.1%, successfully landing within the upgraded 3% to 3.5% guidance range, while full-year margins hit 21%.

guided.metric: FY26 Constant Currency Revenue Growth Guidance
guided.guidance: Full year revenue growth guidance between 2% and 3% in constant currency terms.
guided.source: Q2 FY26 Concall Transcript (21-Oct-2025), PDF p. 3 — "The new guidance is growth between 2% and 3% in constant currency terms for the full year."

guided.guidance: Operating margin guidance remains the same as in the past quarter at 20% to 22% for the full year.
guided.source: Q2 FY26 Concall Transcript (21-Oct-2025), PDF p. 3 — "And our operating margin guidance remains the same as in the past quarter at 20% to 22% for the full year."

delivered.metric: FY26 Constant Currency Revenue Growth Guidance
delivered.actual: Revenue growth in 9 months stood at 2.8%.
delivered.source: Q3 FY26 Concall Transcript (19-Jan-2026), PDF p. 21 — "our revenue growth in 9 months stood at 2.8%, which is at the higher end of our earlier guided range."

delivered.actual: Adjusted operating margins for Q3 expanded by 20 basis points to 21.2% sequentially.
delivered.source: Q3 FY26 Concall Transcript (19-Jan-2026), PDF p. 22 — "Adjusted operating margins for Q3 expanded by 20 basis points to 21.2% sequentially."

quarters.commentary: Infosys posted 9-month revenue growth of 2.8%, near the top end of its prior 2% to 3% band, prompting an upward guidance revision, while adjusted operating margins held steady at 21.2%.

narrative_vs_numbers.pattern: Management demonstrates disciplined margin defense via Project Maximus to consistently hit the 21% midpoint of its 20% to 22% band, while using quarterly guidance updates to adjust growth estimates dynamically in response to macro volatility.
